directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Sidorovich, I've had it with these mobsters. What would you say if I wanted to hop the fence, make nice with the loners again? Can you vouch for me?
entries.JA_current: Sidorovich, I've had it with these mobsters. What would you say if I wanted to hop the fence, make nice with the loners again? Can you vouch for me?
entries.JA_new: シドロヴィッチ、バンディット暮らしにはもううんざりだ。柵を越えて、ローナーの仲間に戻りたいと言ったらどうする？　口添えしてくれるか？

entries.EN: Well now, what's the matter? Life of a bandit a little tougher than you expected so you come crawling back with your tail between your legs like a beaten dog, eh?... Look, Marked One, you are a capable guy so I can handle this matter for you because we need guys like you, doesn't mean I have to like it. As restitution for the damages you may have caused and for your error in judgment, I'm gonna have to charge you a fat lump of cash, consider it your repentance. Pay me 40 thousand rubles and I'll let everyone know you're one of us again. Don't mess it up, my reputation is at stake here!

entries.JA_new: さて、何があった？　バンディット暮らしは思ったよりきつかったか？　負け犬みたいに尻尾を巻いて戻ってきたってわけだな……いいか、印付き。お前は使える奴だ。こっちもお前みたいな人間が必要だから、話をつけてやる。気に入ったわけじゃないぞ。お前が与えた損害と判断を誤った償いとして、大金を払ってもらう。懺悔のつもりで4万ルーブル出せ。そうすれば、お前がまた仲間に戻ったと皆に伝えてやる。しくじるなよ。俺の評判もかかってるんだ！

entries.EN: No, thanks, I've changed my mind.
entries.JA_current: No, thanks, I've changed my mind.
entries.JA_new: いや、やめておく。気が変わった。
